interpretation.passed_bounded: Only the stated asset/action/build was observed. Check evidence period; old runs are not current-candidate retests.
interpretation.not_tested: No sufficient recorded evidence; not a declaration of incompatibility.
interpretation.unsupported_tested_path: The named tested entity/consumer cannot perform the function; other paths are not inferred.
interpretation.compile: Model or resource compilation for this target, not game loading.
interpretation.platform: execution_platform is the actual game host; native compiler build/CI is recorded separately.
interpretation.assets: User and Valve models/screenshots remain local; tracked reports retain provenance without redistributing assets.

gmod_plum_1212.scope: Plum: 28 render cases; full materials and facial pixel differences; LOD geometry/selection; 18-body ragdoll. Original asset is not distributed.

gmod_helpers_1223.scope: GMod 2026.10.08 authored fixtures: 6 client/2 server checks, actual bodygroups, VRM expression/material/spring callback, LOD and procedural bone, 2-body collision.

gmod_physics_1229.scope: GMod 2026.10.10, gm_flatgrass: Plum player/NPC 21-body output including 3 hair bodies; 20-second runs, settling and convex geometry inspection.

source1_layout_1216.scope: CSGO four models, MCV three models; separate HLMV and in-game observations. Extended VTX layout selected by actual target AppID.

csgo_procedural_1222.scope: CSGO 1.38.8.1/build8802, de_dust2: 10 cloth fixtures, Rotation and two-segment IK playback, reload. Visual nominal phases, not exact bone-angle equivalence.

l4d_load_1223.scope: L4D2 2.2.4.3/build10097, c1m1_hotel: three actual prop_dynamic models, model-name readback and visible geometry/materials. Existing L4D2Bridge64 host.

l4d_consumer_1223.scope: Bodygroup 1 to 2 readback passes; all three standard prop_dynamic entities lack m_flexWeight. Does not establish other entity classes lack flex.

insurgency_1223.scope: Three authored models compiled and installed; own build9810 process reached contact. No reliable task-model spawn/readback, so no runtime model capability is accepted.

toolkit_1237.scope: Windows packaged421 compatibility tests; preserved Plum native/CE/Neko compile/validation/decompile. Linux GCC/Clang421 each and actual package verification. Not game execution.

ag2_body_1237.scope: Complete SAS plain/1.1 model: materials, proportional difference, P2000/M4A4 holding, firing, reload, crouch. First-person used stock graph. Candidate provenance bridge is not a second gameplay run.

ag2_view_1238.scope: Actual ResourceCompiler accepted generated view wrappers and complete SAS/custom-helper models; decoded tracks, graph control parameters and isolated model modifications checked. Generated-graph gameplay remains pending.

imports_1238.scope: Windows name/skin/VPK/cache/bake/USD targeted tests, OpenUSD reference and real Blender export world-position comparisons. No game-runtime evidence.

blender_vmd_1238.scope: Real Blender-authored asymmetric eight-bone leg mesh: bind/weight/DMX joint and numeric FK skinning comparison; no game/production-rig certification.

current_development.build: Local MSVC Release dynamic CRT/IPO off
current_development.limits: This is not a final distribution/complete33 acceptance. C4D authoring validation and complete game scenarios remain separate.
New baseline/sanitizer/package gates are configured; do not substitute historical CI for current execution. Windows-only C4D helper is not shipped.
